sources: https://www.kansasstatefair.gov/p/general-information1/facility-rentals1/rv-park-info (read 2026-11-06; same text in Wayback captures of 2026-05-21 and 2026-10-02): 'The Kansas State Fairgrounds RV Park contains 211 full service 50 amp hook-ups'; 'The park is open year round for all RV campers to use'; 'other than the month of September when the Kansas State Fair is taking place, our rates are as follows: $30/per night or $180 per week. Rates are subject to change and rates can vary depending on events'; 'As of February, 2025 the (non-fair) monthly RV rate is $700'; 'Payment can be made at the RV Park payment drop box ... All credit card transactions are subject to a 3% processing fee'; 'Throughout the year, the Kansas State Fairgrounds will host several RV rallies ... call 620-669-3600 ... and make sure a spot will be available'; entrance by Gate 1, 2000 N. Poplar St.

https://www.kansasstatefair.gov/p/participate/commercial-vendors/commercial-vendor-info/campground-rv-park1 (Commercial Vendor Manual, read 2026-11-06): fair-period RV Park is by prepaid reservation through the Facility Rental Department, (620) 669-3608; 'The RV Park fills up early'; 'Full Fair Rate (09/07/2027 thru 09/20/2027 at 11:00 a.m.) $700.00'; 'Before 09/07/2026 and/or after 09/20/2026 $30.00 per day' (the page mixes 2026 and 2027 dates).

https://budget.kansas.gov/wp-content/uploads/373-KSF-Budget-Narrative-FY-2026.pdf (via search summary 2026-11-06): the Kansas State Fair is its own State of Kansas agency (373), run by the statutory Kansas State Fair Board (K.S.A. 74-520 ff.).
Esri World Imagery around 38.080,-97.925 (900 m half-width), 2026-11-06: RV pad rows in the north-west part of the fairgrounds; the stored pin 38.08,-97.93 sits at their south edge.

season.source: https://www.kansasstatefair.gov/p/general-information1/facility-rentals1/rv-park-info ('open year round for all RV campers to use'), read 2026-11-06

values.note: Outside the fair, pull in and pay at the drop box by the entrance; rallies fill the park at times, so call ahead. During the September fair (about Sept 7-20) it is by prepaid reservation through the Fair's Facility Rental Department and fills early.

Outside the September fair: $30 a night or $180 a week ('rates can vary depending on events'); $700 for about 30 nights (stated as of February 2025). Fair period: $700 for the whole fair. 3% card fee.

fees.source: https://www.kansasstatefair.gov/p/general-information1/facility-rentals1/rv-park-info ('$30/per night or $180 per week'), current page read 2026-11-06 and unchanged in a 2026-10-02 Wayback capture; vendor manual 'Before 09/07/2026 and/or after 09/20/2026 $30.00 per day'

note: State fairgrounds RV park at the north end of the Hutchinson fairgrounds, entered by Gate 1 (2000 N Poplar St), a few blocks from the Cosmosphere and Strataca salt mine. Storm shelter in 4-H Centennial Hall. RV Life 4.5*/$$. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 211 full-hookup 50 A sites, year round, $30 a night (current page, also stated for dates outside the 2026 fair). Ownership state stands (Kansas State Fair is a state agency under the State Fair Board). Added the booking note (drop-box pay outside the fair; prepaid reservations and full during the ~Sept 7-20 fair) and the weekly/monthly/fair rates. Note cleaned. Closure banner on the site is commented-out code, not live.
flags: Closure banner: the RV park page's HTML contains an 'Important Notice' modal saying 'The Kansas State Fairgrounds and the Fairgrounds RV Park are both closed to vehicle traffic until further notice', but it sits inside an HTML comment (<!-- HOMEPAGE POPUP > ... <END HOMEPAGE POPUP -->), so browsers never show it; the same commented block is in the 2026-05-21 capture. A web search found the only such closure was the 2020 COVID one. Not treated as a closure. A browser-rendered check would settle it.

September fair: the park is effectively unavailable to a walk-up traveller during the fair (about Sept 7-20; prepaid fair-long reservations at $700, 'fills up early'); rallies through the year can also fill it (named: Campers on a Mission, FCRV Campvention, Kansas Good Sams Rally, Heavy Duty Trucks, Kansas Prairie Winnies, FMCA). Captured in the booking note.
Ownership state confirmed: Kansas State Fair is a separate State of Kansas agency (budget agency 373) governed by the Kansas State Fair Board; policy_ref none stays (not KDWP).

Long-stay share: monthly rate offered ($700/~30 nights, as of Feb 2025) and fair-long reservations; no seasonal-resident signs on the page; a state fairground park selling nights all year passes the long-stay tests.
Phone 620-669-3600 confirmed; after hours 620-669-3630; fair-time reservations (620) 669-3608. Website stands. Pin fine. No sand issue. Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands (no water).
